title: Reviews
summary: What buyers say about your birds. Read every review and reply, because everyone can see your replies.

sections.title: What is this page?
sections.intro: After a buyer receives an order, they can give a star rating (1 to 5) and write a review about the product. This page lists the reviews of your products. You can read them and reply.

blocks.title: In simple words
items: You only see reviews of your own products.
A buyer shows with a short name such as "Rahim K.". You never see their phone, email or id.
Reviews and your replies are public. They show on the product page and on your public shop page.
You cannot hide or delete a review. If a review breaks the rules, you can report it (see below).

sections.title: Why does it matter to you?

items: Stars and reviews are the first thing a new buyer reads. A good rating brings more orders.
Your replies show that you care. Even a bad review can help you, if you answer politely and fix the problem.
Reviews tell you what to improve: the pictures, the packing, the delivery time or the bird itself.

blocks.title: The three cards at the top

items.means: The average of all your published reviews, out of 5.
How many reviews you have not answered yet.
How many reviews have a low number of stars. Read these first.

blocks.title: How to find a review
steps: Use the product filter to see reviews of one product.
Use the stars filter to see only 1-star, or only 5-star, and so on.
Choose "Not answered yet" to see only the ones without your reply.

blocks.text: A review that an admin hid is not shown to anyone, and it leaves your list.

blocks.title: How to
steps: Open a review. Read the stars, the title and the comment. Look at the pictures.
Click in the Reply box and write your reply. It must be between 1 and 1000 characters.
Send it. It shows with your shop name and a "Seller" badge.

blocks.title: Good to know
items: You can reply to the review, or to any reply in its thread. You can write as many replies as you like.
You can edit your own reply for 30 days.
You cannot delete a reply. Deleting is switched off. Edit it instead.

sections.title: How to write a good reply

items: Say thank you first, even for a bad review.
Be calm and polite. Never argue. Other buyers are reading.
Say what you will do: "I am sorry. Please message me with your order number and I will fix this."
For a 5-star review, a short "Thank you, I hope your birds do well" is enough.

sections.title: Report a review that breaks the rules

blocks.title: How to
steps: Choose a reason: spam, abusive, fake, irrelevant or other. Add a note if you want.

blocks.text: Only report reviews that are really wrong. You cannot report the same review twice while a report is open. A bad rating that is honest is not a reason to report.

items.q: A buyer gave a wrong review. Can I delete it?
items.a: No. Reply politely, or report it if it breaks the rules. A moderator decides.

items.q: Can I answer if my account is suspended?
items.a: No. You can read reviews but only an active seller can reply or report.
On every product page, in your products list, and on your public shop page.
